narrative.firstVisit: You wake upon a bare floor in an empty room with a single closed door. On the floor lies a single document. You pick it up. It is an identity document with your own photograph: Vermin Black.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The room is bare, cold, and quiet. Whenever the lights pop and reality resets, you find yourself standing precisely where you first woke.
narrative.overview: You wake upon a bare floor in an empty room with a single closed door. On the floor lies a single document. You pick it up. It is an identity document with your own photograph: Vermin Black.

hiddenSpots.name: Loose Skirting Board
hiddenSpots.text: Prying back a splintered baseboard reveals a forgotten cache of medical supplies.

hiddenSpots.name: Hollow Plaster Wall
hiddenSpots.text: Tapping the wall reveals a hollow space behind the wallpaper containing fine grey ash.

actions.title: Examine Identity Document
actions.desc: Inspect the government identity papers confirming your name as Vermin Black.

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: Name: Vermin Black. The signature and face match without contradiction. You are yourself.

transcript.speaker: Thought
transcript.text: The letters blur momentarily, but the photograph is unmistakably your own.

actions.title: Ending I: Unlock the Door & Step Into Morning Light
actions.desc: Turn the Verdict Key with open eyes, carrying every remembered name out of the Shifting Space (Clarity Ending).

transcript.speaker: Ending I - Lucid Awakening
transcript.text: The black alloy key turns without resistance. Beyond the waking door there is no whirring projector, no coarse rag, and no painted numeral - only cold, unforgiving morning daylight and the sound of a distant siren. You step across the threshold knowing exactly who Vermin Black is, and for the first time, the lights do not pop.

morality.reason: Stepped into the waking accounting with full lucidity

addJournalChronicle.title: Finale: Lucid Awakening
addJournalChronicle.text: Unlocked the waking room door with the Verdict Key and stepped into daylight without looking away from the ledger.

actions.title: Ending II: Snap the Key & Claim the Architecture
actions.desc: Break the Verdict Key beneath your heel and assume cold dominion over the Shifting Space (Fracture Ending).

transcript.speaker: Ending II - The Eternal Clinician
transcript.text: You place the Verdict Key upon the bare floorboards and snap its bow cleanly with your boot. The corridors beyond the wall stop shifting against you and begin shifting for you. A brass reception bell chimes faintly in the distance. Every ward, mirror, and archive belongs to Dr. Vermin Black forever.

morality.reason: Claimed dominion over the Shifting Space

addJournalChronicle.title: Finale: The Eternal Clinician
addJournalChronicle.text: Rejected release and claimed mastery over the shifting corridors as their detached architect.

actions.title: Ending III: Wait for the Bulb to Pop
actions.desc: Set the Verdict Key beside your identity document and let the filament snap into calm repetition (Loop Ending).

transcript.speaker: Ending III - The Popped Bulb
transcript.text: You lay the black alloy key neatly beside the folded identity document and sit upon the bare boards. Overhead, the tungsten filament brightens once, pops softly, and plunges the room into familiar dark. When your eyes open again, the pain is gone, the door is shut, and the count stands ready at IX.

addJournalChronicle.title: Finale: The Popped Bulb
addJournalChronicle.text: Chose the quiet stillness of the repeating room, letting the overhead filament reset the architecture.

narrative.firstVisit: The room is dark. An old silent film projector sits on a table in the center, whirring softly without projecting an image. On the floor beside the tripod rests a lit brass lantern.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The hum of the projector motor reverberates against the bare plaster walls. Shadows stretch across the floor.
narrative.overview: The room is dark. An old silent film projector sits on a table in the center, whirring softly without projecting an image. On the floor beside the tripod rests a lit brass lantern.

hiddenSpots.name: Table Underside
hiddenSpots.text: Taped beneath the projector stand is an empty glass laboratory vial.

actions.title: Inspect Whirring Projector
actions.desc: Examine the lens and spools of the silent 35mm projector.

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: The projector has no film loaded, yet its shutter clicks continuously at 24 frames per second.

transcript.speaker: Observation
transcript.text: The shutter clicks rhythmically in the dark.

actions.title: Thread the Unlabelled 35mm Reel
actions.desc: Mount the kitchen celluloid canister onto the whirring projector spindle to see what it records.

transcript.speaker: Case File #000
transcript.text: The celluloid catches with a sharp click. Grainy frames flicker across the plaster: your own gloved hand drafting floorplans of an empty waking room, a chairless table, and a green armchair. Beside the lens rests a cold black alloy ring.

morality.reason: Confronted the authorship of the Shifting Space

addJournalChronicle.title: Case File #000: The Silent Reel
addJournalChronicle.text: Threaded the unlabelled 35mm reel into the projector. The footage revealed Vermin Black himself drafting the shifting corridors.

actions.title: Track the Numeral Afterimages
actions.desc: Repeat the flashing crimson sequence cast by the whirring projector to salvage Void Ash or Clarity Crystal.

narrative.firstVisit: A cold draft carries a sickly sweet, toxic emission. In the center of the passage, a coarse rag hangs suspended in mid-air as if an invisible person stood beneath it. In the corner sits a small bottle of pain-killing elixir.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The air here remains heavy and chilled. The outline of a newly revealed door stands clearly against the wall.
narrative.overview: A cold draft carries a sickly sweet, toxic emission. In the center of the passage, a coarse rag hangs suspended in mid-air as if an invisible person stood beneath it. In the corner sits a small bottle of pain-killing elixir.

hiddenSpots.name: Floor Air Grate
hiddenSpots.text: Prying up the iron vent reveals tangled threads of entity cloth.

actions.title: Drink Pain-Killing Elixir
actions.desc: Consume the expensive pain elixir to numb the toxic nausea and clear your vision.

transcript.speaker: Medication
transcript.text: You uncork the bottle and swallow the bitter elixir. The throbbing ache behind your temples subsides and the shifting room steadies into focus. A closed door appears ahead.

narrative.firstVisit: You stand at the threshold of a long hallway covered in faded floral carpet. A loose paper rests upon the rug. A human-like entity darts across the dividing archway and vanishes into thin air.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The long hallway stretches forward quietly. The carpet muffles your footsteps.
narrative.overview: You stand at the threshold of a long hallway covered in faded floral carpet. A loose paper rests upon the rug. A human-like entity darts across the dividing archway and vanishes into thin air.

hiddenSpots.name: Folded Carpet Seam
hiddenSpots.text: Lifting the edge of the moldy carpet exposes a sterile bandage cloth.

hiddenSpots.name: Sconce Bracket
hiddenSpots.text: Behind the rusted wall sconce rests a cluster of popped glass shards.

actions.title: Read Found Journal Paper
actions.desc: Read the handwritten page regarding Bella and Braxton.

transcript.speaker: Memory
transcript.text: You recognize your own handwriting immediately. The childhood memory of butchering Bella and Braxton in the upstairs bathtub to teach your parents a lesson. Good memories.

transcript.speaker: Memory
transcript.text: The words describe the blade sliding around the neck of the barking dog. A neat message.

narrative.firstVisit: A dead end. Where the cloud of ash and embers collapsed, an ornate wind-up music box sits in dead silence upon the floorboards.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The dead end alcove is silent. Ash dust clings to the plaster molding.
narrative.overview: A dead end. Where the cloud of ash and embers collapsed, an ornate wind-up music box sits in dead silence upon the floorboards.

hiddenSpots.name: Ash Heap
hiddenSpots.text: Scooping up the residue where the cloud vanished yields ash dust.

actions.title: Silence the Winding Mechanism
actions.desc: Inspect the four etched harmonic notes on the rattling brass music box to still its embers.

narrative.firstVisit: You enter a square room with two closed doors. On the central wall, freshly daubed in wet crimson fluid, is a Roman numeral: IX. Below it is written in neat script: 'Nine.'
narrative.subsequentVisit: The central antechamber remains the axis of the space. The Roman numerals on the plaster wall mark your progress through the rooms.
narrative.overview: You enter a square room with two closed doors. On the central wall, freshly daubed in wet crimson fluid, is a Roman numeral: IX. Below it is written in neat script: 'Nine.'

hiddenSpots.name: Warped Floor Tile
hiddenSpots.text: Lifting the creaking tile uncovers a small iron key stamped with the letter A.

hiddenSpots.name: Overhead Cornice
hiddenSpots.text: Reaching into the shadow above the doorframe reveals a clarity crystal shard.

actions.title: Examine Crimson Numeral
actions.desc: Inspect the freshly painted Roman numerals on the central wall.

transcript.speaker: Analysis
transcript.text: The substance is human blood. Creative. The numeral represents a countdown: IX, VIII, VII...

transcript.speaker: Analysis
transcript.text: Fresh blood. It smells metallic and sharp.

actions.title: Stand Before the Crimson Numerals
actions.desc: Hold your breath before the bleeding Roman numerals and measure your pulse against The Final Verdict.

transcript.speaker: The Final Verdict
transcript.text: The wet paint smells of iron and antiseptic. You trace the sequence with steady eyes: every numeral corresponds to a room you once sealed away in memory.

morality.reason: Measured the Verdict with lucid composure

transcript.speaker: The Final Verdict
transcript.text: A bulb overhead hums louder until your teeth ache. The crimson strokes seem to shift whenever you blink, yet you refuse to step back.

actions.title: Steady the Buzzing Overhead Filament
actions.desc: Calibrate three surges before the bulb pops to recover Glass Shards or a Void Crystal.

narrative.firstVisit: You step into a dark kitchen. A long countertop stands in the gloom. An entity sprints past the refrigerator door and vanishes into shadow. On the kitchen table lies a 35mm film reel.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The kitchen is quiet. The hum of an unpowered refrigerator vibrates faintly through the tile floor.
narrative.overview: You step into a dark kitchen. A long countertop stands in the gloom. An entity sprints past the refrigerator door and vanishes into shadow. On the kitchen table lies a 35mm film reel.

hiddenSpots.name: Under-Sink Cupboard
hiddenSpots.text: Searching the cupboard yields a heavy iron key stamped with the letter C.

actions.title: Restore Kitchen Lights
actions.desc: Investigate the light switch beside the film reel table.

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: The light pops loudly, casting the room into pitch black before blazing back on. A wall has vanished, revealing a dining room with three mirrors!

transcript.speaker: Observation
transcript.text: The switch sparks, and after a moment of darkness, the adjoining wall dissolves into a dining room.

actions.title: Clinical Compounding Mortar
actions.desc: Grind entity ash and cabinet residue upon the steel counter to distill restorative tonics.

narrative.firstVisit: A long mahogany dining table covered in a green tablecloth sits in the center of the room. Curiously, there are no chairs whatsoever. Along the wall hang three large ornate mirrors.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The green tablecloth hangs down to the floorboards. The three wall mirrors reflect your solitary, clinical silhouette.

hiddenSpots.name: Behind Center Mirror
hiddenSpots.text: Reaching behind the glass frame reveals an empty medicine vial.

actions.title: Examine the Triad of Reflections
actions.desc: Decipher the inscription spanning the three silvered mirrors above the chairless table.

actions.title: Cast the Roman Numerals
actions.desc: Roll four stamped ivory tally blocks across the chairless polished table to test the space.

narrative.firstVisit: A small, well-lit room covered entirely in dark wooden paneling. At first glance it appears to be a dead end, until you close the entry door and notice an open gap above the ceiling continuing around a left corner.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The smell of aged varnish and cedar paneling fills the small chamber.
narrative.overview: A small, well-lit room covered entirely in dark wooden paneling. At first glance it appears to be a dead end, until you close the entry door and notice an open gap above the ceiling continuing around a left corner.

hiddenSpots.name: Concealed Wood Latch
hiddenSpots.text: Pressing the wood knot releases a spring-loaded slot with void ash.

actions.title: Decode the Architectural Turn
actions.desc: Read the directional runes carved into the cedar doorframe to chart the true path through the labyrinth.

narrative.firstVisit: You stand staring down a long, branching corridor with multiple paths. The lights pop and return without alteration. One way in, one way out. You are inside a maze.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The paneled corridors branch left and right with disorienting geometric precision.
narrative.overview: You stand staring down a long, branching corridor with multiple paths. The lights pop and return without alteration. One way in, one way out. You are inside a maze.

hiddenSpots.name: Loose Wainscot Panel
hiddenSpots.text: Prying back the panel exposes a bundle of sterile bandage cloth.

narrative.firstVisit: You follow the right branch into a small rectangular room. When you turn around, the hallway you entered from is gone - replaced by a solid blank wall.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The small rectangular dead end sits motionless in the dim light.
narrative.overview: You follow the right branch into a small rectangular room. When you turn around, the hallway you entered from is gone - replaced by a solid blank wall.

hiddenSpots.name: Corner Molding
hiddenSpots.text: A sharp glass shard is wedged into the corner molding.

actions.title: Tap the Hollow Cedar Seams
actions.desc: Probe the warped wood paneling where dark resin oozes between the seams.

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: Behind the dead-end panel you scrape free a thick bead of Void Resin and uncover scratched tally marks left by earlier loops.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The cedar splinters under your knuckles, yielding only a thin smear of dark resin and the distant sound of a door closing elsewhere.

narrative.firstVisit: A strange zig-zag path turns sharply through blind right-angle corners. As you navigate the angles, vivid memories of the clinic reception and deceived patients flood your mind.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The zig-zag corridor turns sharply through the wood-paneled gloom.
narrative.overview: A strange zig-zag path turns sharply through blind right-angle corners. As you navigate the angles, vivid memories of the clinic reception and deceived patients flood your mind.

hiddenSpots.name: Blind Angle Niche
hiddenSpots.text: Behind the sharp turn lies a pool of congealed void resin.

actions.title: Shadow Entity Stalk
actions.desc: Match your stride to the rhythm of popping bulbs and unseen footsteps to salvage medicine vials.

narrative.firstVisit: You emerge from the zig-zag turns into a small chamber with a single wooden door. Beyond this door, you can hear the faint hum of the two-door antechamber.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The exit chamber stands quiet. The door opens cleanly back into the central room.
narrative.overview: You emerge from the zig-zag turns into a small chamber with a single wooden door. Beyond this door, you can hear the faint hum of the two-door antechamber.

hiddenSpots.name: Threshold Crevice
hiddenSpots.text: Beneath the threshold plate lies a small vial of ash dust.

actions.title: Salvage the Refracting Shard
actions.desc: Inspect the cracked overhead fixture where crystalline light pools across the bare center floor.

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: Nestled among shattered bulb filaments lies an intact Void Crystal Shard that hums softly when lifted toward your lantern.

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: You sift through the broken bulb glass and recover a small Clarity Crystal facet intact.

narrative.firstVisit: You step into the room and hear a wet, squishing sound beneath your sole. Blood coats the walls, visceral matter covers the floor, and dark droplets drip rhythmically from the ceiling. Someone played and did not clean up afterward.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The metallic odor of drying blood clings heavily to the plaster and floorboards.
narrative.overview: You step into the room and hear a wet, squishing sound beneath your sole. Blood coats the walls, visceral matter covers the floor, and dark droplets drip rhythmically from the ceiling. Someone played and did not clean up afterward.

hiddenSpots.name: Under Organic Coil
hiddenSpots.text: Clearing aside cold matter exposes blood-tempered iron.

actions.title: Survey Anatomical Scene
actions.desc: Methodically inspect the arrangement of severed matter and dripping fluids.

transcript.speaker: Clinical Analysis
transcript.text: Inefficient technique. Tying the torso and face down with intestines works far better when stuffing guts back inside. The lights pop and the room enlarges dramatically.

transcript.speaker: Observation
transcript.text: Untidy craftsmanship. The lights flicker and the room extends backward.

narrative.firstVisit: The enlarged expanse of the room stretches into cold shadow. More blood-covered walls and surgical debris. In the center rests a heavy key stamped with the letter B.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The vast dissection chamber stands silent. The corner door leads back to the antechamber.
narrative.overview: The enlarged expanse of the room stretches into cold shadow. More blood-covered walls and surgical debris. In the center rests a heavy key stamped with the letter B.

hiddenSpots.name: Floor Drainage Gutter
hiddenSpots.text: Searching the gutter turns up an intact medication bottle.

hiddenSpots.name: Overhead Meat Hook
hiddenSpots.text: Unfastening a rusted iron hook from the beam provides a brutal off-hand weapon.

actions.title: Void Crucible Focus
actions.desc: Focus lantern light over the dissection bench to temper blood-hardened iron.

narrative.firstVisit: Just visible in the dim light ahead sits a single armchair upholstered in rich green fabric with an ornate golden wooden frame. It faces away from you toward three closed doors.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The green armchair rests upon the floorboards like an empty throne awaiting an occupant.
narrative.overview: Just visible in the dim light ahead sits a single armchair upholstered in rich green fabric with an ornate golden wooden frame. It faces away from you toward three closed doors.

hiddenSpots.text: Reaching between the golden frame cushions reveals a clarity crystal.

actions.title: Examine Green Armchair
actions.desc: Inspect the gilded frame and emerald upholstery of the solitary chair.

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: The upholstery is pristine. Carved into the golden armrest are tiny Roman numerals counting from IX to zero. The door to the clinic lobby unlocks.

transcript.speaker: Observation
transcript.text: The chair smells faintly of antiseptic and leather.

narrative.firstVisit: Fluorescent tubes hum overhead, illuminating an institutional reception lobby. Behind the desk sits the receptionist, while an agitated man in a rumpled suit paces nervously clutching a dispatch notice.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The reception lobby hums with sterile fluorescent light. Orderlies stand silently by the frosted glass doors.

hiddenSpots.name: Intake Document Tray
hiddenSpots.text: Sorting through intake forms reveals an unissued Self-Admission Contract.

narrative.subsequentVisit: The filing room smells of dry paper, ink, and iron drawers.
narrative.overview: Floor-to-ceiling olive-drab iron filing cabinets line the walls. Behind a desk stacked high with manila folders sits the Archivist, methodically stamping patient commitment forms.

hiddenSpots.name: False Drawer Bottom
hiddenSpots.text: Prying up the false metal bottom uncovers an entity ward charm.

actions.title: Audit the Self-Admission Ledger
actions.desc: Review the stamped involuntary commitment contracts stacked beside the Archivist desk.

transcript.speaker: Clinical Archive
transcript.text: Page after page bears the same deceptive complaint header over binding self-admission clauses. You pocket a signed copy and a clean laboratory vial tucked inside the binder.

transcript.speaker: Clinical Archive
transcript.text: The ink smudges under the fluorescent hum, yet your own neat signature at the bottom of every intake page is unmistakable.

narrative.firstVisit: White subway tiles line the cold room. In the center sits an enameled clawfoot bathtub stained with rusty brown streaks. On the edge of the sink rests a handwritten diary and an open medicine cabinet.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The porcelain bathtub stands cold and hollow under the single dangling bulb.

hiddenSpots.name: Medicine Cabinet
hiddenSpots.text: Inside the mirrored cabinet behind the mirror lies the father's shaving blade.

actions.title: Inspect Clawfoot Bathtub
actions.desc: Examine the stains and drainage pipe of the childhood tub.

transcript.speaker: Memory
transcript.text: You remember pressing Bella down with your left hand while drawing the blade in a slow curve around her neck. She made a terrible noise. Braxton was quieter.

transcript.speaker: Memory
transcript.text: The rusted enamel carries the ghost of canine blood.

actions.title: Open the Mirrored Medicine Cabinet
actions.desc: Swing open the rusted bathroom cabinet above the sink where your father kept his shaving gear.

transcript.speaker: Childhood Artifact
transcript.text: Inside the cabinet sits your father's heavy steel shaving blade beside an unopened vial. The steel feels cold, balanced, and terribly familiar.

transcript.speaker: Childhood Artifact
transcript.text: The rusted hinge shrieks as you pull the mirror open and lift the shaving blade from the glass shelf.

narrative.firstVisit: A gallery lined with cracked, full-length mirrors. Your reflection walks independently across several panes, holding razors and contracts while regarding you with cold curiosity.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The mirror hall hums with optical dissonance. Your reflection mimics your every motion perfectly once more.
narrative.overview: A gallery lined with cracked, full-length mirrors. Your reflection walks independently across several panes, holding razors and contracts while regarding you with cold curiosity.

hiddenSpots.name: Shattered Mirror Panes
hiddenSpots.text: Prying loose a jagged pane yields a pristine void crystal shard.

actions.title: Entity Clashing Brace
actions.desc: Steady your stance and brace against lunging reflections behind the fractured silver glass.

actions.title: Gaze Into the Fractured Mirrors
actions.desc: Hold your own stare across a dozen cracked reflections to separate clinical memory from delusion.

transcript.speaker: Lucid Reflection
transcript.text: Every shard shows a different room you have walked tonight. One reflection does not blink; beneath its frame you pry loose a gleaming Clarity Crystal.

morality.reason: Refused to look away from the fractured mirrors

transcript.speaker: Fractured Reflection
transcript.text: A crack runs suddenly across the silver glass, splitting your smile in two. Cold detachment rushes in to fill the silence.

morality.reason: Embraced cold detachment in the Mirror Hall

locations.name: The Edge of the Void Abyss

narrative.firstVisit: The corridor floor drops away into an infinite, starless abyss. At the precipice stands the translucent figure of a young woman, weeping softly into her hands.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The cold wind of the void rises from the drop. Ahead stands the massive double door leading to the final judgment.
narrative.overview: The corridor floor drops away into an infinite, starless abyss. At the precipice stands the translucent figure of a young woman, weeping softly into her hands.

hiddenSpots.name: Chasm Ledge
hiddenSpots.text: Anchored to the stone ledge is a heavy void-stained trenchcoat.

actions.title: Listen to the Silence Between Walls
actions.desc: Step to the dark precipice and attune your awareness to The Consuming Void.

transcript.speaker: The Consuming Void
transcript.text: Between the distant pops of dying filaments, the Void answers with absolute stillness. Fine Void Ash settles like frost upon your sleeve.

transcript.speaker: The Consuming Void
transcript.text: The drop has no bottom, yet your lantern beam reveals faint architectural chalk lines suspended in nothingness.

locations.name: The Hall of the Final Verdict

narrative.firstVisit: An immense, windowless amphitheater lined with empty benches. Crimson numerals burn on all four walls: IX through I, descending to zero. In the center rests the green armchair, surrounded by swirling ash.
narrative.subsequentVisit: The amphitheater is silent. The entity has dissolved. At the far end of the hall, a solitary door stands open, leading back into the empty room where you first awoke.
narrative.overview: An immense, windowless amphitheater lined with empty benches. Crimson numerals burn on all four walls: IX through I, descending to zero. In the center rests the green armchair, surrounded by swirling ash.

hiddenSpots.name: Center Armchair Pedestal
hiddenSpots.text: Beneath the gilded pedestal lies a cache of refined clarity tonics.

actions.title: Sit upon the Green Armchair
actions.desc: Take your seat in the gilded chair and accept the final accounting.

transcript.speaker: The Verdict
transcript.text: You sit upon the green fabric. The crimson numerals flare blinding white. The room screams as the collective weight of your deeds condenses into physical form!

transcript.speaker: The Verdict
transcript.text: You sit upon the chair. The room assembles its reckoning.

actions.title: Speak the Tally Inscription
actions.desc: Inspect the pedestal beneath the green armchair where Roman numerals IX through I await the final word.
